And now, from far out beyond the bay, a song is coming over the water; down on the old street, people with lamps have straightened up one after another and are walking slowly out toward the distant retreating water, smiling, not looking back. In the right foreground, on the wet battlement of a fortress of blue-grey stone, in full profile facing left toward the sea, an old human woman of ninety-seven in a dark shawl stands gripping the wall with both hands and singing back out over the bay, her mouth wide open, her white hair blown. Below her on a water gate at the foot of the fortress, facing us, the sea-haired tide keeper stands with her right arm raised and her left hand cupped at her mouth, shouting to the people on the bay floor: long wet deep sea-blue hair, thin silver fins at her temples, iridescent scales on her cheekbones and neck, a slit deep blue robe, a copper-bound shell at her belt. High above them, on top of the fortress's tall stone guild tower, a beacon fire burns and a red-haired woman feeds it. Far out on the open sea along the horizon, rows of pale faces seem to float and sing. Lamp-glow and sea mist drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 选二幕第2504-2508行，水退到珠湾的塔尖露出来、几千盏灯在湾底捡潮、湾外起了那一支歌、人提着灯往水那边走、塔玛的祖母在堡墙上唱回去、她在水门上喊上来那一阵。祖母九十七岁，没有立绘。楼顶添火的塔玛只是远处的小人。

nodes.name: 湾的喉咙
nodes.light: a cold blue glow rising from the glowing lines in the water and lighting the face of the wave, against the black sky before dawn
nodes.camera: low on the reef at her side, the turning wall of water filling the upper half behind her; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the dark hour after midnight at the narrow mouth of a deep bay, where two black reefs reach out from either side like two hands almost closing, and all the water of the bay must pass between them. Beyond them, over the open sea, comes a single wave taller than the cliffs, a white line stretched from one end of the sky to the other, now towering black and close, its crest curling. On the southern reef, close in the foreground, kneels the sea-haired tide keeper, facing us, at the very edge of the rock above the rushing gap: long deep sea-blue hair streaming wet, a crown of thin silver fins at her temples, deep blue eyes, a soaked deep blue robe slit at the sides, bare feet on the wet stone. Her left hand, on the viewer's right, is held out over the water palm down, cut open across the palm, and her blood is dripping into the sea; her right hand still holds a spiral shell whose cracked lip is bound with copper. Her mouth is open: she is singing low to the water. Where her blood falls it does not cloud: it runs away through the dark water in long thin lines glowing bright blue, branching like veins, out into the open sea and back into the bay. And at this instant the great wave is twisting aside, as if pulled from far out at sea, its whole towering face lit blue from within by the lines, turning away from the bay mouth toward the open ocean. Along her left side, on the viewer's right, from the cheekbone down the neck and the arm, the fine iridescent scales are turning dark, almost black, like a snake's back. Behind her on the reef, a dozen fisherfolk cling to the rock, staring. Spray and drops of blue light fly large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 选三幕第2523-2529行，她在湾的喉咙那块礁上拿海螺的裂口划开左手、血滴进水里长出一根一根发蓝的线、那一道浪顺着蓝线往外海去、她左边那半身的鳞变黑那一下。舌头上放盐是前一拍，立的那一句不写进画里。 主会话：口子只画在掌心，不画到手腕。

nodes.name: 浮灯
nodes.light: the clear blue flames of the floating lamps lighting the water and her face from below, against a dark calm night sky
nodes.camera: close beside the tower window, looking past her out over the lines of blue floating lamps on the bay; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a calm night in early winter over a deep bay where a fortress of blue-grey stone has slid halfway into the water: its walls run slanting down into the sea, half its windows now doors under the waves, and its tall stone guild tower stands tilted with the sea lapping high up its sides. Across the bay, where the streets of the old harbour towns now lie under shallow water, dozens of small lamps float on the surface in long lines marking every waterway that can still be used, each made from an empty wine barrel and a copper basin and burning with a clear blue flame; a slow swell is passing under them and they rise with it, sending a band of blue light toward the shore. In the foreground, at a high window of the tilted tower, leaning out over the water and facing us, is the red-haired beacon keeper: a tall narrow-shouldered human woman of thirty-two, fire-red hair tied back with an old strip of cloth, a few front locks curled from old singeing, teal-green eyes red-rimmed from smoke, burn scars layered on the backs of her hands; a thick grey wool coat with burn holes in the cuffs, a copper fire-striker and a short hatchet at her belt, an old copper nail on a cord at her neck. With both hands she is knotting a fresh rope from a floating barrel-lamp onto the stone window frame, so that it will rise and fall with the tide; the blue flame lights her face from below, her mouth set, a small satisfied gleam in her eyes. Far off along the bay, on the roofs of the harbour towns, small figures are tying lamps of their own. Blue sparks and sea mist drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束取塔玛扎的浮灯（第2536行），初雪月沿沉下去的街一条能走的水路插一盏，七座城守灯的人跟着学，灯油是海兽的油，火是蓝的。

nodes.name: 半指
nodes.light: the warm yellow light of one hand lamp held up from below, against the cold blue-black of a frosty winter night
nodes.camera: low on the frosted bottom step, looking up past the lamp and the ladder at the carved lintel; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a frosty winter night, past midnight, at the great door of a court of pale white stone in a big city, frost white on the long flight of steps. Above the tall closed doors runs a broad stone lintel carved with one long line of inscription, drawn only as rows of cut strokes, not as any readable letters; two of the carved marks in the middle look shallow and soft-edged, like stone worn by years of river water. A long wooden ladder leans against the lintel. Near the top of it, seen in full profile facing left, a young human stonemason of twenty: tall, thick-forearmed, short copper-red hair dusted white with stone powder, very pale blue eyes, a leather apron with three chisels in its pocket, sleeves rolled to the elbow; his left hand grips the ladder and he presses two fingers of his right hand into one of the shallow carved strokes, measuring, his face intent and troubled. At the foot of the ladder, facing us and looking up at him, an old human magistrate of sixty-seven in a plain black robe with a coat thrown over his shoulders holds a hand lamp high in his right hand. Beside him on the left, in full profile facing right, a young woman scribe of twenty-one with a mop of dandelion-yellow curls cut to the chin, a reed pen tucked behind her left ear, a patched old wool coat and a grey-blue scarf, holds up a small wooden board in both hands, a line of ink strokes on it. Behind them on the steps a thirteen-year-old boy apprentice wrapped in a quilt stares up. Far off below, the dark river and a bridge with a few lamps. Frost glitter and the breath of the people drift out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第23到25行：汉讷斯在梯子上拿指头量刻痕“浅了半指”，尤斯图斯举灯，洛伦娜写下那一行的木牌，小学徒披着被子。门楣上的字只画刻痕，那两个字画成浅的。

nodes.name: 铜长凳
who: the copper-haired empress with a plain old sword
the rope-maker in the blue headscarf
nodes.light: the cold grey-blue light before dawn over the river mist, with the warm yellow of a lamp set at the foot of the bench
nodes.camera: low on the riverbank path in front of the bench, the three women and the long row of plaques behind them; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the grey-blue hour before dawn on a long riverbank of reed huts in a great city, mist lying on the broad dark river. Along the bank a stone river wall is set with a long row of upright bronze account plaques, one after another into the distance, each covered with rows of small cut marks, no readable letters. In front of them stand three heavy benches cast in dark bronze; on the middle one, which has a backrest, sits the copper-haired empress with a plain old sword: a young-looking woman of twenty-seven or so, deep gold-brown hair with an old-copper sheen worn to the shoulders and tied low at the nape, pale gold eyes, a thin white scar at the end of her left eyebrow, an old burn scar on the back of her right hand, facing us: a plain dark travelling cloak over a white-gold and old-bronze uniform coat, an old leather belt with a plain straight sword whose grip is wound in hemp rope. Her hands rest on her knees and her face is quiet, listening. Beside her on the bench, in full profile facing left toward her, sits the rope-maker in the blue headscarf, a tall thin woman who looks a little over fifty in an old dark long coat, black hair with streaks of white under the knotted blue scarf, twisting a short length of cord between her long fingers; a small lamp stands on the stones at her feet. On the empress's other side stands, facing us, a young woman of twenty: tall, thin and very straight, straight black hair with a blue sheen cut level at the shoulders, narrow spectacles, pale violet eyes, a dark grey long scholar's robe buttoned to the throat with black sleeve-covers under a too-long old cloak; she holds a thick bound daybook against her chest with one arm and a lamp in the other hand, her lips parted, reading names aloud. Far behind, the lit white towers of the city's crown-hill rise over the river. River mist and reed fluff drift out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕第29到31行：她坐在河岸审那一处中间那一条铜长凳上，朵萝西娅举灯报榜上的名字，桑娜出来坐在旁边搓绳。三条长凳照碑三条长凳。账碑上的字画成刻痕。朵萝西娅没有立绘，照旅伴条写。

nodes.name: 认得
nodes.light: the first clean gold of a winter sunrise from the right, against the cool blue shadow of the white court steps
nodes.camera: low on the bottom step behind the row of children, looking up past them at the lintel and the ladder; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: winter sunrise at the great door of a court of pale white stone, frost melting on the long flight of steps, the first gold light striking the carved stone lintel above the door. The lintel is carved with one long line of inscription drawn only as rows of cut strokes, no readable letters, and along two of the strokes in the middle a thin line of fresh pale light runs as they deepen again. On the bottom step a row of a dozen poor children from the reed-hut slums, aged seven to fourteen, stand side by side in patched coats and scarves, each holding a small slate, seen from behind, all looking up. In front of them, in full profile facing right, an eleven-year-old girl with two short flaxen braids, a grown-up's old wool coat cut down for her with the sleeves rolled, a knitted scarf pulled down from her chin, holds one hand up high and reads aloud with her head tilted back, her mouth open, her face bright and serious. High on a ladder against the lintel, facing us, a young copper-haired stonemason with stone dust on his hair has two fingers of his right hand in the carving and looks down at the girl in surprise. On the steps above the children, in full profile facing left, an old magistrate in a black robe stands with his hands at his sides; beside him a woman clerk in grey holds a tall stack of copied papers in her arms. Crowding the steps and the street behind, three hundred townsfolk of the docks and the lower city watch in silence. Sunlit frost and breath drift out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第41行：尤斯图斯问这一行谁认得，排头的缇蕾举手说我认得、仰头念，门楣上的刻痕跟着深回来，汉讷斯的手指在刻痕里。缇蕾十一岁，只写个子和穿戴；孩子们背影。字只画刻痕。

nodes.name: 铜孩子
nodes.light: the soft gold of an early spring morning from the left, against the cool white of the stone
nodes.camera: low on the paving in front of the new monument, the bronze girl and the real children at the centre; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: an early spring morning on a festival day at the foot of the long white steps of a court in a great city. At the bottom of the steps stands a new monument: a free-standing doorframe of white stone the size of a great door, two plain posts and a plain lintel, with no wall around it, a small blank bronze plate set into the foot of the left post. Under the doorframe stands a small cast bronze statue of a girl in a long dress and an apron, her head tilted back, one arm raised pointing at the lintel, her mouth open as if reading aloud; a line of small pebbles lies along the threshold. Before the monument a row of poor children from the reed-hut slums, seen from behind, stand looking up at the lintel with slates in their hands. In the near left foreground, in full profile facing right, a young copper-haired stonemason of twenty-one in a leather apron, a canvas chisel bag on his back, has just stepped back from the monument and rests his palm flat on the left post, satisfied. Beside the children, facing us, a young woman scribe with dandelion-yellow curls and a reed pen behind her ear holds a folded writing board under her arm, smiling. Among the children, one twelve-year-old girl with two short flaxen braids turns her head in full profile to look at the bronze girl. Townsfolk with spring flowers stand on the steps behind. Blossom petals and morning dust drift out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第52到53行：780年黎明日苇棚区的人家请碑，汉讷斯凿的白石门框，门框底下仰头念字的铜孩子，往后苇棚区的孩子先念门楣。碑面字画成刻痕，碑牌留空。缇蕾那一年十二岁。

nodes.name: 缺了一口
nodes.light: the cold pale glow of a white band on the far southern horizon, against the deep blue-black of an autumn night over the hills
nodes.camera: low on the flat rock behind the two women, looking past them to the far horizon; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: an autumn night on the highest ridge of dry yellow-earth hills, a flat-topped boulder on the crest, the wind blowing from the right. Far away on the southern horizon lies a long low band of pale white glow along the edge of a dead land, and its lower left end has a dark bite taken out of it, a darker shape creeping inside the glow. On the flat rock, seen from behind, sit two women. On the left, an old woman of sixty-four of a deer-eared folk, two short brown deer ears among grey hair tied back, a weathered fur-lined hunter's coat, sits very still with one arm raised, pointing at the bite in the glow. On the right, a tall young half-orc huntress of nineteen, broader in the shoulders than any man, pale grey-green skin, straw-gold hair cut to the jaw with one thick braid down the left side, two small copper rings in her left ear, a tanned deerskin jerkin with the sleeves pushed up, a tall oak-shafted two-pronged hunting fork slung across her back, turns her head in full profile toward the old woman, her brow drawn, trying to see. A water skin and a sack of dried meat lie on the rock beside them. Below the ridge, small and dark, the roofs of a hunters' village in a gully with two or three lit windows. Dry grass seeds and night dust drift out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第14行：坠叶月下旬五日夜里，琼妲在望石上先看见天边那一块白缺了一口，碰了碰雅兹嘉指给她看。都背影或侧面，琼妲、雅兹嘉没有立绘，照条目写。

nodes.name: 门外
who: the woman in the dark travelling cloak, seen from behind
nodes.light: the cold white glow of the great wall behind, from above, against the dark mass of beasts and the blackness of the night plain
nodes.camera: low on the road just behind her right shoulder, looking past her at the beasts, the wall's foot curving away on both sides; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night on a bare plain at the foot of a great white wall that runs away to both horizons, a closed heavy gate behind and above the camera, the wall's stones glowing faintly white. On the road thirty paces out from the gate, seen directly from behind, stands a slender young woman with deep gold-brown hair with an old-copper sheen worn to the shoulders and tied low at the nape, a plain dark travelling cloak over a white-gold and old-bronze uniform coat, an old leather belt with a plain straight sword wound in hemp rope at her left hip; her right hand rests on the sword's hilt and the sword stays in its sheath, her left arm hangs at her side, her feet planted, quite still. Beside her on the right stands a low old roadside stone with a worn groove on its top. Three paces in front of her stands the leader of a tide of bone-hyenas: hyena-like beasts with grey hides, long forelegs and sloping backs, white bone growing out of their backs in clusters like flowers, the small ones like wolves, the big ones like oxen: a monstrous beast as tall as a watchtower, its back blooming with white bone up over its shoulders, a long white mane trailing to the ground, the bones of its face grown half-way toward a human face, its eye sockets empty; its head is lowered and it has stopped. Behind it a dozen huge ones taller than oxen stand in a half-circle, halted. Beyond them, from horizon to horizon, a vast dark tide of thousands of bone-hyenas pours toward the wall, and just before the woman it parts in two like water against a ship's bow, one stream turning left and one turning right along the foot of the wall. High on the wall far to the left, a beacon fire burns. Grey dust and white spittle-threads shine out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕幕终第38、39行：领在前头的十几头停在她跟前，潮在她跟前分成两股顺着墙脚绕过去，她手按剑柄、剑没出鞘。她背影，照碑分潮那一尊的样子。路边那块石头是门外一夜。骸鬣照补卷_16和魔物骸鬣那一条，领头那一头照主线。

nodes.name: 开缝
nodes.light: the orange light of torches on the wall from behind and above, against the cold blue-black of the breach and the beasts beyond
nodes.camera: low inside the breach behind the line of planks, looking out over the shoulders of the defenders; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the hour before dawn inside a breach two fathoms wide in a great wall of pale stone, the broken stones piled on both sides, torches burning on the wall above. Across the breach stands a makeshift barrier of old house doors pulled off their hinges, some still carrying a family's small door plate, held upright by a front row of soldiers in grey coats and hunters in leather; a second row thrusts spears out through the gaps between the doors. Outside the barrier, beyond its edge, bone-hyenas: hyena-like beasts with grey hides, long forelegs and sloping backs, white bone growing out of their backs in clusters like flowers, the small ones like wolves, the big ones like oxen pile up on one another, white bone on their backs gleaming in the torchlight, jaws open, one big one rearing over the top. In the middle of the front row, in full profile facing left, a young soldier of nineteen, tall and broad-shouldered, wildly curly flax-coloured hair with flour still in it, a line of freckles across his nose, a new grey soldier's coat and an old belt with a tin tag on his chest, braces his back against a door with both forearms crossed over it, his face strained and fierce, shouting an order over his shoulder; at his signal the front row is stepping back half a pace together to open a narrow gap, through which three beasts are tumbling in onto the waiting spears. Behind on the wall a young wolf-eared courier with white hair black at the tips runs along the top, mouth open in song. Sparks, dust and splinters fly out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第49行：天亮以前最难的那一个钟点，豁牙那一截门板一块一块叫咬碎，吉多顶在头一块板后头喊开一条缝放进来几头再落，门板阵一回一回提闸落闸；布莉塔沿墙头唱。吉多、布莉塔没有立绘，照条目写。

nodes.name: 磨坊面包
who: the copper-haired empress with a plain old sword
nodes.light: the low clear gold of the morning sun from the left, against the long cool shadow of the white wall
nodes.camera: low on the road beside the stone, the empress, the old woman and the open gate in one view; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a clear autumn morning just after sunrise outside the south gate of a fortress on a great white wall, the heavy gate standing open, the bare plain beyond empty to the horizon, where a long pale white band lies along the edge of the land again. Beside the road, thirty paces out from the gate, sits on a low old roadside stone with a worn groove on its top the copper-haired empress with a plain old sword: a young-looking woman of twenty-seven or so, deep gold-brown hair with an old-copper sheen worn to the shoulders and tied low at the nape, pale gold eyes, a thin white scar at the end of her left eyebrow, an old burn scar on the back of her right hand, a plain dark travelling cloak over a white-gold and old-bronze uniform coat, a plain straight sword wound in hemp rope at her hip. She is seen in full profile facing right, holding a round loaf of brown bread in both hands, a bite taken from it, looking up at an old woman of seventy-one who stands before her, facing her in full profile: small and bent, a white headscarf, a flour-dusted apron over a dark wool dress, her hands folded. In the shadow of the gate passage behind them, facing us, a young soldier with curly flax-coloured hair leans on the opened gate, watching. On the wall above, small soldiers and hunters look down. Morning dust and a few drifting dry leaves glow out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第55、56行：中旬六日早上她在门外一夜那块石头上坐了一会儿，薇苒拿出磨坊家的面包叫她坐着吃，她吃完问水车还转不转。吉多在门洞里。

nodes.name: 冰上霜画
nodes.light: the warm orange firelight spilling from the open hall door on the right, against the deep blue-black of the arctic night and a faint green aurora
nodes.camera: low on the ice behind the ring of children, the old woman, the frost picture and the lit doorway in one view; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a clear, bitterly cold night in the far north, on smooth dark ice just outside the open door of a great timber longhall at the head of a long snowy valley. The hall's long roof ridge is one huge pale whale bone, white with frost, and warm orange firelight spills from the doorway across the ice. Snowy mountains rise behind under a deep blue-black sky with a faint green aurora low over the peaks. On the ice at the right, seen in full profile facing left, sits a small bent old woman of seventy-six: a white headscarf over grey braids, a heavy wolf-fur coat over a faded white robe, her left hand resting on a short walking stick planted on the ice, her right hand lifted a little as she tells a story, her mouth open. Facing her in a loose half-ring sit six small children of three to eleven bundled in white robes and fur coats, seen from behind, wide-eyed; the smallest leans asleep against an older girl. On the ice between them, white hoarfrost has grown by itself into a delicate picture like an etching: a tall jagged mountain, and in front of it one very small human figure standing still, as if it has just stopped walking. The frost picture glints faintly blue-white. Breath steam rises from every mouth. Snow crystals drift out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第19行：上旬三日夜里格萝在冰上讲那一座山的故事，讲到得有人对这座山说一句话就停下了，冰面上的霜照着故事长出一座山，山前头站着一个很小的人，停在那里不动了。格萝没有立绘，照人物白母口北边那三座长厅里的人那一条写。

nodes.name: 别回头
who: the guest in the worn grey travelling coat, in profile
nodes.light: the last cold violet dusk light over the snow, with the warm orange of torches at a longhall door on the right
nodes.camera: low in the snow beside the lead cart, both women in profile, the blocked pass towering behind; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dusk in deep snow at the foot of a mountain pass blocked by a landslide. Behind, a towering wall of broken rock and ice fills the pass from cliff top to cliff foot, steaming faintly, with picks and shovels stuck in its base and a shallow dug notch. In the middle ground a line of heavy covered ox-carts stands in the snow, a small sheaf of wheat straw tied as a flag on each canopy, and at the right a low timber longhall with a pair of huge pale antlers over its door and torches lit along it. In the foreground beside the lead cart, in full profile facing right, stands a sturdy young woman of nineteen of the far north, long-legged, a thick pale-gold braid hanging down her back, deep fjord-blue eyes, eyelashes white by birth and rimmed with frost, a faded white robe with a bear raising its head embroidered at the hem, a wolf-fur coat over it, fingerless gloves with her pale fingertips bare; she holds a long peeled birch pole level in both hands, the pole cut along its length with many small notches, and runs the pale fingertip of her right hand along the notches while her left hand holds the far end, reading them, her lips moving. Facing her, in full profile facing left, stands a tall young-looking woman of about twenty-seven, deep gold-brown hair with an old-copper sheen tied low at the nape, pale gold eyes, a thin white scar at the tail of her left eyebrow, a worn plain grey wool travelling coat buttoned to the throat, a plain straight sword wound in hemp rope at her left hip, a small brass bell tied on a cord at her right wrist; she stands still with both hands at her sides, listening closely. On the lead cart's shaft behind them sits an old halfling man, as tall as a man's chest, a round youthful face lined with age and a big grey-white beard tucked into a scarf, an open ledger on his knees and a pencil stopped in his right hand. Snowflakes and torch sparks drift out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕第30行：上旬六日傍晚斯瓦拉从山脊上下来，在头车前头把杆子横过来一道一道摸过去，念完了户数，说别回头；客人说记下了，宾尼在货页上添了二百一十七户。斯瓦拉、宾尼没有立绘，照条目写。

nodes.name: 开岭
who: the woman in the worn grey travelling coat, seen from behind
nodes.light: the pale gold and blue light of dawn from behind the top of the wall, and a bright thin light shining through the fresh cut
nodes.camera: low in the snow at the foot of the slope just behind the woman, looking up the whole wall to the swordsman on top; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dawn after a night of wind at a mountain pass blocked by a landslide; a towering wall of broken rock and ice fills the pass from the cliff top to its foot. At its very top, on the highest block of ice and rock, small against the pale gold-and-blue dawn sky, stands a tall thin young swordsman of twenty in full profile facing left: short platinum-blond hair blown straight back by the wind, sky-blue eyes, cheeks red with cold, a tiny copper bell hanging at his left earlobe, a high-collared felt cloak streaming behind him, old leather armour with an iron plate on the left shoulder, a coil of hemp rope at the back of his belt, old leather gloves. His right hand is just pushing a long narrow single-edged sword back into a white-wood scabbard bound with iron at his left hip, his left hand holding the scabbard's mouth; he stands balanced and quite still. Below him, straight down the whole face of the ice-and-rock wall from top to foot, one clean straight cut has just opened, wide enough for an ox-cart, its two walls flat as if sliced, pale light shining through it from the far side; the snow along the top of the wall is parted to both sides along one line, and a thin ribbon of wind and snow streams out through the cut. At the foot of the slope, seen directly from behind in the foreground, stands a tall young-looking woman of about twenty-seven, deep gold-brown hair with an old-copper sheen tied low at the nape, pale gold eyes, a thin white scar at the tail of her left eyebrow, a worn plain grey wool travelling coat buttoned to the throat, a plain straight sword wound in hemp rope at her left hip, her hands at her sides, looking up. To her left and right along the slope stand a dozen small carters in thick wool coats, picks and shovels lowered, all stopped and looking up. Snow dust and ice glitter drift out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第40、41行：上旬九日天亮艾德温一个人上了崩口，不系绳，在最高的那一块冰石上站住，拔剑，左耳上那一只铜铃响了一声，剑已经回了鞘，崩口从顶上裂到脚下，一道缝慢慢张开，宽得过一辆车。客人站在坡脚上，凿了三天的人都停了手。艾德温没有立绘，照条目写；她背影。

nodes.name: 画霜
nodes.light: the warm gold of the lantern from the left, against the cold blue starlight and snow
nodes.camera: low in the snow at the side of the longhall door, both figures in profile, the frost line on the door clearly seen; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a deep winter night in the far north outside the heavy plank door of a great timber longhall half-buried in snow, its roof ridge of pale whale bone glittering with frost, stars and a faint green aurora above. At the door, in full profile facing right, stands a sturdy young woman of nineteen of the far north, long-legged, a thick pale-gold braid hanging down her back, deep fjord-blue eyes, eyelashes white by birth and rimmed with frost, a faded white robe with a bear raising its head embroidered at the hem, a wolf-fur coat over it, fingerless gloves with her pale fingertips bare; she reaches out her right hand and draws one bare fingertip slowly down the edge of the closed door, and where her fingertip passes a thin bright line of white hoarfrost blooms along the crack and seals it; her left hand hangs at her side. Just behind her, also in full profile facing right, stands a broad-shouldered young carter of twenty-two: untidy short straw-coloured hair, green eyes, big ears red with cold, the flaps of his felt cap turned up, a thick knee-length wool driving coat with shiny worn cuffs, a cattle whip coiled at his belt with a tiny bunch of dry wheat ears tied to its tip; he holds a lit iron lantern up in his right hand to light the door for her, his left hand at his side. Warm lantern light falls on the frosted door and the snow; far down the valley two more longhalls glow faintly beside a frozen fjord. Snow crystals drift out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第50行：那一冬斯瓦拉每夜给三座厅的门画霜，沃纳拎着灯跟在后头，三座厅的麦吃到开春，没有饿死一个人。两个人都没有立绘，照条目写。

贾比尔.when: 山铜纪742年炎潮月中旬三日
贾比尔.where: 苍焰角城七道弯的第七道弯
贾比尔.how: 瓦尔德拉克手里那一截断角扎穿了他的心。他问雨城门洞里的篮子那一夜领走了没有，瓦尔德拉克说没有都领走，替他掰断了左角上的铁环。他埋在第七道弯底下，那一截角跟着他埋了。

宴主十二家.when: 山铜纪758年霜降月上旬十日
宴主十二家.how: 十一家的家主和坐在身边的那一位，连同第十二席的叔叔，二十三个人喝了那一口起假了的宴约。终舞以后他们举着杯朝首席站到天亮，血从指尖黑到肘弯，中午倒下，杯子还攥在手里。

安布罗斯.when: 山铜纪758年霜降月上旬十日天亮以前
安布罗斯.how: 银盘上冒出一点残火，他伸手去捧。莉西娅说“你可以拒绝”，他说“我拒绝”，那一点火烧进了他手里，烧完熄了。他倒在舞厅里，那一处地上往后什么也不烂，铺了一块石板。

卡律丝.when: 山铜纪803年初雪月中旬四日天亮以前
卡律丝.how: 她两只手按着城的倒影守了四十九夜，城回到了岸上。湖底那一团东西撒手以前最后拽了一把，拽走了她自己的倒影，人跟着也就走了。镜匠昂迪娜给她披上斗篷，背着她离开了湖岸。

高巢的那几家.when: 山铜纪824年坠叶月上旬九日夜里
高巢的那几家.how: 塔顶那十一个老人坐在灯房门底下，领头的是赫丝珀，说什么也不肯下来。塔离了崖，落进湾口外头的海里，十一个人一个也没有出来。名字是赛勒斐恩一个一个报给碑匠的。

科维恩.when: 山铜纪824年坠叶月上旬九日夜里
科维恩.how: 他从崖边扑下去攥住第七艘的锚缆，拍了三下翅膀，把船拖回了航路，第三下把羽骨里的命也拍尽了。锚缆扯断，他攥着那一截落进了倒井那一圈海里，照崖上的规矩没有捞上来。

锁在一条链子上的三千个人.when: 山铜纪847年清露月到长曦月
锁在一条链子上的三千个人.how: 三千个人跟格罗姆锁在一条链子上走进荒地，走到台心剩两千三百四十个，台心那一夜掉了一千一百多截，往回走又掉了六十截。死了的人锁自己开，人留在荒地里，回到锻营门口的是一千一百个。

法伊勒.how: 那几营在议事的石屋里议了三天，判她死。格罗姆没有进那间屋子，行刑是他去的，一锤，舍克尔站在边上，没有转开脸。她死以前最后问的一句，是问她儿子吃了没有。

哈坎·四桨.when: 山铜纪861年坠叶月下旬三日夜里
哈坎·四桨.how: 他看见身后七座城的灯一盏一盏灭了，把慢潮掉过头往湾口划，四只手一齐上桨，拖着两条船冲进了湾口，回头去接第三条，叫浪扣在了礁外头。下旬六日早上老锚渡摆渡的捞上来他，四只手还攥着桨。

deaths.name: 慢潮
who: the four-armed old fisherman with a cane
deaths.light: the cold grey-blue dark of the sea before dawn, the faint white of the rising wave line far behind, no lamps anywhere
deaths.camera: low on the water inside the bay mouth, looking out at the rower with the reefs on either side and the white line beyond; a little tilted
deaths.text: Scene: past midnight at the narrow mouth of a deep bay, between two black reefs that reach out like two hands, the sea heaving and pulling hard outward. Inside the bay behind, the whole coast is dark: every harbour lamp has gone out, leaving only the black shapes of drowned towns. Two small fishing boats have just been dragged through the gap into the shelter of the southern reef, their young crews clinging on and looking back. In the middle of the gap, a battered old fishing boat with a faded sea-blue hull is heading out again toward the open sea, into the pull. At its centre thwart, facing us, sits the four-armed old fisherman with a cane, rowing with everything he has: a broad-framed demon-kin of the deep-tide snake folk with faded grey-green scales, sea-blue hair whipped loose from its short tail, yellow slit-pupilled eyes narrowed against the spray, a short oilcloth jacket with four armholes soaked and belted tight. All four arms are pulling oars: the two thick upper arms on one long pair, the two thinner lower arms, growing from his ribs, on a second pair; the lower left hand, on the viewer's right, is missing two fingers and grips its oar all the same. A wooden tide slip swings on a cord at his neck, and his polished oar-handle cane lies in the bottom of the boat. His face is set and calm, his mouth shut. Far behind him, out beyond the bow on the open sea, a white line stretches from one end of the dark horizon to the other, rising taller than the reefs. Spray and flying foam rush large and out of focus across the near corners.
deaths.note: 选他最后被人看见的那一下（第2516、2723行），拖着两条船冲进湾口、回头去接第三条；慢潮叫浪扣在礁外头那一下不画。四条胳膊写明，少两根指头的是下面那一只左手。

notes: 乌戈855年寒星月死在雷狱一扇门外，收束里写了，可那是回来八年以后老死的，我写了死期和死的那一刻，不算的话两样一起拿掉。
死在这一段剧情里、相遇名单上没有的几位没写死期：苍焰角城的法里斯（头一天死在伊德娜背上），最后一尊的奥兹伦·碗主（自己走上高座），深潮蓝堡的妮洛丝（凝名的四位里只有她不在名单上，死在双礁港的堤上），要的话添进名单再补。
瓦尔德拉克、格罗姆、莉西娅、莫尔图斯的立绘是往后的样子（断角上的二十道、紫色枝杈和角上的锁、散发缠刺、戴不戴水晶），凝名以前那几幅 text 里写明了那一刻的样子，出图时要盯着别照立绘画回去。
巴尔缇娜的常服和战斗那一套腰上带着她自造的火药枪，四幅都挑了正装那一套，text 写明只拿笔或空手。
凯撒法庭这一条没有死期：多拉801年、尤斯图斯791年都是几十年以后老死的，同样没写的还有西比拉838年、贝内特839年、奥萝843年。
雷暴荒地的收束挑了锻营门口锁自己弹开那一刻，没有落在848年那块碑上，要落在碑上可以换成碑脚下盘着的那条链子。
凯撒法庭一幕挑的是金穗月那一晚钱袋坠地，没有挑开局皮姆在南仓窗口外数出十六枚那一下，一幕的标题就是十六枚。
镜殿那一幅巴尔缇娜到的日子源稿几处不一（主线收束写寒星月中旬，碰得上的人写初雪月下旬），这一幅没写日子。
莎蒂和酒窖那七个孩子、斯特凡、努尔、萝塔、蓓雅都只画了被救下、坐着、睡着的样子，没有受伤的画面。
主会话：乌戈 是几十年以后老死的，照月银纪那一本的口径不算死在这段剧情里，死期和死的那一刻挪进 later_fates、later_deaths。

乌戈.when: 山铜纪855年寒星月中旬九日
乌戈.how: 一个新关进来的年轻人过头一夜，他在门外头坐着。天亮的时候那个年轻人隔着门叫他，他没有应，坐着的样子跟平常一样。格罗姆把他埋在桩底下，博鲁旁边，他到最后也没有想起来自己从前是谁。

later_deaths.name: 门外守夜
later_deaths.light: the single small warm lamp in the niche beside him, against the cold blue-grey dark of the underground corridor and the faint grey dawn far down it
later_deaths.camera: low on the corridor floor a little way off, looking at the seated old man and the barred door beside him; a little tilted
later_deaths.text: Scene: a winter night deep underground in a prison dug into the earth at the edge of a storm wasteland, a narrow curving stone corridor lined with heavy iron-bound doors, each door carved with a short row of marks. A single small oil lamp burns in a niche. Outside the last door in the row, on a small wooden stool with four even legs, sits the old horn-sawn warden, facing us, his back against the stone wall beside the door: very tall even sitting, gaunt and big-framed, his back stooped, deep bronze skin with an ashen grey cast, close-cropped iron-grey hair, eyebrows half white, very pale grey eyes; his horns are sawn off flat at the roots, the stumps worn smooth and shiny; an old dark brown wool coat patched many times and short in the sleeves, three loops of iron chain wound round his waist with the clasps turned outward, a small branded mark at his collarbone. His big hands rest open on his knees. His eyes are half closed and his face is mild and peaceful, as if listening. Through the small barred window in the door beside him, a young man's hand reaches out and rests on the bars, and a young face presses close in the dark behind them, no longer crying. On the floor by the stool stand a clay bowl of water and a little jar of lamp oil. Far down the corridor, at a bend, the faint grey light of coming dawn shows from the stair. Dust in the lamplight drifts out of focus across the near corners.
later_deaths.note: 选855年寒星月中旬九日那一夜（第2258、2384行），他坐在一个新关进来的年轻人门外头过头一夜，天亮以前还坐着的那一下，不画他天亮没有应的那一下。他是收束里讲到的死，可那是回来八年以后老死的，算不算死在这一段剧情里拿不准，见 notes。
